review_notes: I reviewed all 82 lines of Main.lean. I did not open the imported files, because the question was only whether this file repeats nontrivial reasoning. The only repetition is the pattern `filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℕ)] with l hl` followed by `approximatingSet_card_two_le (by omega)`. It appears in `tendsto_growthExponent_approximatingSet` and in `isLUB_admissibleExponents`. In `sSup_admissibleExponents` the same card bound is used with `by norm_num`. Each occurrence is a one- or two-line wrapper around existing API, and the rubric treats that as too short to extract. The other proofs (`sSup_admissibleExponents`, `supremum_not_attained`) are short applications of `growthExponent_lt_two` and `isLUB_csSup` with no shared nontrivial argument. A helper lemma would save almost nothing and would not make the file easier to read or maintain.
